documents.abstract: A series of hybrids comprising of 5-cyanopyrimidine and quinoline moiety were synthesized and tested for in vitro antiplasmodial activity against NF54 and Dd2 strains of Plasmodium falciparum. Hybrid bearing m-nitrophenyl substituent at C-4 of pyrimidine displayed the highest antiplasmodial activity [IC50 = 56 nM] against the CQ(R) (Dd2) strain, which is four-fold greater than CQ.
documents.authors: Kaur H, Balzarini J, de Kock C, Smith PJ, Chibale K, Singh K.
documents.title: Synthesis, antiplasmodial activity and mechanistic studies of pyrimidine-5-carbonitrile and quinoline hybrids.
